After breakfast, the sightseeing tour of the capital begins.

The first stop is La Candelaria, a historic district with colonial buildings, churches and narrow streets. Bogotá's older architecture is particularly well preserved here.

One of the main stops is the Gold Museum, which houses an exceptional collection of pre-Hispanic gold objects and more than 20,000 pre-Columbian exhibits.

Next, visit the Casa de la Moneda, the old mint dating to the 17th century, and the Fernando Botero Museum. Botero donated a large collection of his work to the city. The museum also displays works by Dalí and other European artists.

After the museums, continue to Plaza de Bolívar, home to the cathedral and other important buildings in the historic centre. If the route passes the presidential palace around 17:00, you may see the changing of the guard.

The tour ends with a funicular ride up Monserrate, which rises about 500 metres above the city. At the summit is the 17th-century Cathedral of the Black Madonna, and the viewpoint offers panoramic views of Bogotá.

The tour also includes a tasting of Helado de Paila ice cream.

**Duration:** 7 hours.

**Included:** the ascent of Monserrate, admission to the Gold Museum, a Helado de Paila tasting, guide services, private transport and a local medical assistance card.

After breakfast, head to Zipaquirá to visit the Salt Cathedral, built underground inside a former salt mine.

After visiting the cathedral and having lunch, which **is not included in the price**, continue to Villa de Leyva.

Along the way, pass the Boyacá Bridge, associated with a major event in the history of Colombia's independence.

Villa de Leyva has preserved many of its colonial buildings. Its large historic square is surrounded by restaurants, cafés, hotels and museums. The town was designated a historic and cultural monument in the late 1950s.

In the evening, check in to the hotel and stay overnight.

**Tour duration:** 10 hours.

**Included:** a bilingual guide, private transport and a local medical assistance card.
